page: Google Cloud Platform m4-megamem-56 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the m4 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 56 dedicated vCPUs alongside 744.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of approximately 13.29 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The high memory density of the m4-megamem-56 makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require massive RAM footprints relative to compute resources, avoiding the need to provision excess vCPUs simply to obtain sufficient memory. It is suited for large in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, real-time data analytics, and memory-intensive batch processing.
